title: oSzoukaua's: Glow-co
description: Datapack that allows you to set/randomise player team colours!
body:
# Description: This Datapack/mod makes a Simple to use and functional Chat-based UI for changing your own team colour. You can access this menu by typing "**/trigger colour_menu**"

Operator Settings
### Note: a value of 0 means false, a value of 1 means true

Enable/Disable a welcome message for players informing them of the datapacks presence, default: false/0 ``` /scoreboard players set welcome_message oszu_gc 0 ```

Disable the use of the colour menu for players, default: false/0 ``` /scoreboard players set disable_menu oszu_gc 0 ```

Enable/Disable random colour assignment for players on initial join of the world, default: false/0 ``` /scoreboard players set random_colour oszu_gc 0 ```

Enable/Disable random colour every time you join, default: false/0 ``` /scoreboard players set random_colour_every_join oszu_gc 0 ```

### Re-roll
Re-roll a specific players random height ``` /execute as PLAYERNAME run function oszu_gc:colour_logic/randomise_colour ```

### NOTE:
you can use @a as a playername, and it will re-roll the height for all players currently in the server



## Notes:
Server-Side: meaning that it needs to be installed either on a singleplayer world, or on the server host side
